'''Crawford Winery''' is a vineyard located within the [[Auburn Forest]] of [[Northwind]], to the east of [[Ambershire]]. Along with the [[Mildenhall Horse Farm]], it is a part of the agricultural aspects of Northwind that are coordinated by [[Lady Josephine Mildenhall]]. It has recently been invaded by [[orc]]s of the [[Blackrock clan]], forcing the Crawford family to flee to the [[Plump Pumpkin]] inn.
